generated.details: At near-left on the tabletop beside the printer, the plain unlabelled document storage box has rigid warm-gray fiberboard sides and a fitted overlapping lid.
Its rectangular carcass encloses flush doors above a recessed plinth.
The far board-formed concrete wall has shallow horizontal casting seams and subtle timber-grain impressions.
Above the cabinet at far-right, the slim wall sconce has a narrow metal housing fixed to a backplate and a recessed opal diffuser.
